notes.title: Game Update 5.0.3
notes.content: We've just updated the game to the latest version of the HexWar Engine. This includes various bug fixes and performance improvements!

notes.title: Civil War: 1863 - version 5.0.2 update
notes.content: Change: The Bonus 'Opening Shots!' Campaign is now available to all players without requiring an email registration.

notes.title: Civil War: 1863 Version 5.0.1 Update
notes.content: ix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: Civil War: 1863 v5.0.0 Update
notes.content:
Change: Updated the combat capabilities of Cavalry armed only with Pistols.
 Change: Improved A.I. opponent.
 Fix: Missing some mount dismount button options.
 Fix: An error preventing the 'Game Updates' text from appearing.
 Fix: Some screen layout issues.
 Fix: Invalid font selection on some buttons on some platforms.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Fix: Improved memory management.
Fix: Improved hex tile Positioning accuracy.
Add: A Change speed option in settings. This has three options standard, slow and fast which effects how fast the game plays.

For mac users: If the game does not start after you update please uninstall and reinstall the game. 

For any issues please contact : support@hexwar.com

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
We have added two new campaigns to the game.

Arsenal an eight mission campaign and Chickamauga also an 8 mission campaign.

You might also notice some small changes to the UI.

At the moment we at HexWar are very busy updating all our hex engine games.

So far we have updated Civil War 1861, 1862, 1863 and 1864, 1865 should be finished sometime next week.

We would also like to say a big thank you to all our players out there for supporting a small indie company.

notes.title: Civil War: 1863 has been updated!
notes.content:
We've just released the latest update to Civil War: 1863!

Improved tutorial!
We've updated all eight missions in the tutorial campaign.

 Expanded notifications during tutorial to provide more insight into the game system.
 Hex highlights added to improve clarity.
 Notifications remain on screen longer to give players an opportunity to read them.

We'd love to hear any suggestions for any desired new features or any other feedback related to Civil War: 1863.  Thanks for supporting our games!

~ The HexWar Games Team

notes.title: New Campaign Available!
notes.content:
We've just patched Civil War: 1863!

Changes in this version include:
 New 8 scenario "Grand Command" campaign available.  Play as either the Union or the Confederates!
 Achievements have been fixed!
 Improved UI layout on keyboard shortcuts.
 A host of general bug fixes


Thanks for supporting our games and please keep the feedback coming! 

~ The HexWar Games Team
